candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone (not just the owner) can call transferOwnership and change the owner.
Delete the require(newOwner != address(0), ...) check so transferOwnership can set the owner to the zero address instead of reverting.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with a direct _owner = newOwner assignment, so no OwnershipTransferred event is emitted and behavior via transferOwnership differs.
